name: Take an order
needsNote: Nothing: an earlier run's orders are cleaned up first
covers: Starting the app, typing, a drop-down, a tick box, reading what the app shows, waiting for the bar at the bottom, and a checkpoint that checks the saved file and the log

steps.say: Start Order Desk. The runner puts it beside this panel, and every step it takes shows here.
The bar at the bottom says what the app is doing. Tests wait on it rather than for a fixed time: ${ready}
Type Ada Lovelace as the customer, a key at a time, as a person would

steps.what: what the form says is missing
steps.say: Until the form is complete it says what is missing, and a test can read that: ${problem}
Pick Coffee beans from the drop-down

steps.text: Leave it at the back door
steps.say: Add a note for the driver
The form adds it up. The test keeps what it says, to check later: ${total}
The new order is in the list on the right

steps.checkpoint: Ada's order was added and saved

checks.label: The form's total was £26.00: 2 × £12.00, and £2.00 for gift wrap
The bar at the bottom said order 1001 was added
orders.json has the total the form showed

checks.equals: Leave it at the back door

checks.label: The last line of the activity log is about the new order

look: The order is in the list on the right: 1001, Ada Lovelace, 2 × Coffee beans, gift wrapped, £26.00.
The form is empty again, ready for the next order.
